## Intent — what this is for

A CLASSIFICATION atom over PHF-12's census (scripts/generate_inert_surface_baseline.py): it makes the census's verdict on each of the 13 surviving enum surfaces correct and evidence-backed, and deliberately builds no missing writer. Every E(value) construction site behind those surfaces is traced to the origin of its VALUE and classified EXTERNALLY REACHABLE / INTERNAL ONLY / DEAD CALL SITE. The ruling is that E(value) proves reachability only when the construction executes in production AND its value crosses a trust/authoring boundary, which is not expressible as a cheap deterministic AST rule — so the census rule is NOT widened, the shrink-only ratchet is untouched, and the verdict table plus per-member reasons ARE the deliverable. Corrects PHF-12's stated premise that judge_contract.py:342 makes Verdict.REPLAN reachable.
